categories.name: Scholarships
categories.description: Check eligibility, hidden bonds, deadlines, and renewal traps before applying.

suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are the exact eligibility criteria, deadlines, and renewal terms?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify if I qualify, confirm submission deadline, and ensure I can renew it for all four years without conflicting with other financial aid.

questions.text: What are the exact eligibility criteria (GPA, age, nationality)?
questions.whyItMatters: Applying while ineligible wastes effort, incurs non-refundable application fees, and risks disqualification.
questions.suggestedSource: Official Scholarship Gazette or Institutional Policy Document

questions.text: What is the final application submission deadline and time zone?
questions.whyItMatters: Late submissions are rejected automatically by application portals with no recourse.
questions.suggestedSource: Official Application Portal or Directorate Notification

questions.text: Are there family income caps or specific financial thresholds?
questions.whyItMatters: Exceeding the gross family income ceiling invalidates the application even if academic merit is stellar.
questions.suggestedSource: Financial Disclosure Guidelines / Revenue Authority Endorsement

questions.text: What mandatory supporting documents and attestations are required?
questions.whyItMatters: Missing notary stamps, official transcripts, or apostilles causes immediate administrative rejection.
questions.suggestedSource: Checklist Annexure from official issuing authority

questions.text: What does the financial grant cover (tuition, housing, books, stipend)?
questions.whyItMatters: Assuming a scholarship is 'full ride' often leaves hidden student fees, visa fees, and living cost deficits.

questions.text: What are the academic retention and annual renewal conditions?
questions.whyItMatters: Many students lose funding in year 2 because they fell short of renewal GPA or credit requirements.

questions.text: Can this award be combined (stacked) with other scholarships or loans?
questions.whyItMatters: Taking a secondary grant can accidentally void your primary award if exclusivity clauses exist.

questions.text: What is the selection and shortlisting procedure (written test, interview)?
questions.whyItMatters: Interviews often have short preparation windows and mandatory in-person presence.

questions.text: Is there a post-graduation work bond or service agreement obligation?
questions.whyItMatters: Breaching a hidden return-home or government service bond leads to severe financial clawbacks.

questions.text: Is there an appeal or grievance process in case of rejection?
questions.whyItMatters: Clerical errors in transcript evaluation can only be corrected within strict grievance windows.
questions.suggestedSource: Appeals Tribunal or Grievance Cell Policy

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Investigate universities, online degree accreditation, hidden fees, and transfer credits.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence Admission & Accreditation
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: Is this program formally accredited, what are hidden costs, and do credits transfer?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify institutional accreditation, verify total tuition plus hidden facility fees, and check faculty mentorship.

questions.text: Is the institution and specific degree program regionally/professionally accredited?
questions.whyItMatters: Unaccredited degrees are rejected by employers, licensing boards, and graduate schools.

questions.text: What is the true total cost of attendance including lab, tech, and campus fees?
questions.whyItMatters: Tuition quoted on promotional brochures often excludes 20-30% mandatory auxiliary fees.

questions.text: What are the prerequisite courses, test scores (GRE/GMAT), and cutoff bars?
questions.whyItMatters: Missing a foundational mathematics or coding course can delay graduation by a full semester.

questions.text: What is the exact credit transfer policy and maximum transferable credits?
questions.whyItMatters: Previous coursework may not transfer, forcing you to pay for and repeat courses.

questions.text: What are the independently audited career placement rates and median starting salaries?
questions.whyItMatters: Self-reported marketing numbers often count non-degree retail jobs as 'employed'.

questions.text: Is the schedule fully synchronous, asynchronous, or requires mandatory weekend campus visits?
questions.whyItMatters: Working professionals may discover unmanageable weekday lecture requirements.

questions.text: What is the course drop deadline and tuition refund schedule?
questions.whyItMatters: Withdrawing after the first week can forfeit 100% of paid tuition.

questions.text: Who teaches core courses: tenured professors or adjunct instructors?
questions.whyItMatters: Teaching assistant ratios affect letter-of-recommendation access and research opportunities.

categories.name: Career and Employment
categories.description: Inspect job offers, non-competes, probation criteria, equity vesting, and severance.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Senior Software Engineer Job Offer & Employment Contract
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are the true compensation numbers, equity vesting cliffs, and restrictive covenants?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify base salary vs bonus conditions, stock option 1-year cliff, and whether non-compete restricts future roles.

questions.text: What part of compensation is guaranteed base salary vs conditional performance bonus?
questions.whyItMatters: Inflated CTC figures frequently conceal unrealistic KPI-driven discretionary bonuses.

questions.text: What is the equity schedule: vesting cliff, exercise window, and post-termination exercise period (PTEP)?
questions.whyItMatters: A 90-day PTEP can render vested options completely worthless if cash is unavailable during departure.

questions.text: Does the contract include a post-employment non-compete or non-solicitation clause?
questions.whyItMatters: Broad non-competes can legally bar you from working in your specialized industry for 12 months.

questions.text: What is the probation duration, evaluation criteria, and notice period during probation?
questions.whyItMatters: Uncapped probation allows employers to terminate employment with minimal notice and no severance.

questions.text: Is the remote / hybrid arrangement contractually protected or subject to immediate recall?
questions.whyItMatters: Verbal remote promises can be reversed with a mandatory Return-to-Office mandate at any moment.

questions.text: What is the scope of health insurance (family coverage, copays, pre-existing conditions)?
questions.whyItMatters: High deductible insurance plans can result in unexpected out-of-pocket medical expenses.

questions.text: Does the intellectual property assignment clause claim ownership over your personal off-hours projects?
questions.whyItMatters: Overly broad IP clauses can forfeit your personal side businesses, apps, and open-source projects.

questions.text: What is the severance policy and notice period required for termination without cause?
questions.whyItMatters: Standard at-will contracts offer zero severance unless explicitly negotiated in writing.

categories.name: Study Abroad
categories.description: Uncover student visa restrictions, post-study work rights, living costs, and health insurance.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Postgraduate Studies in Germany: Visa, Blocked Account & Work Rights
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are the updated blocked account amounts, part-time work limits, and post-study visas?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify official 2026 blocked account financial requirement, language certification, and stay-back rights.

questions.text: What is the required proof of financial funds (blocked account, bank guarantee amount)?
questions.whyItMatters: Financial requirements increase yearly; underfunding by even €100 halts visa issuance.
questions.suggestedSource: Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Immigration Bureau

questions.text: How many hours per week is an international student legally permitted to work?
questions.whyItMatters: Working beyond the statutory limit constitutes an immigration violation leading to deportation.

questions.text: What is the duration and qualifying criteria for the post-study work visa (stay-back)?
questions.whyItMatters: Changes in government immigration caps can shorten graduate stay-back periods drastically.
questions.suggestedSource: Department of Home Affairs / Interior Ministry

questions.text: What language proficiency tests (IELTS, TOEFL, Goethe) and minimum band scores are mandatory?
questions.whyItMatters: Different university departments often demand higher band minimums than the general visa threshold.

questions.text: Is statutory public health insurance mandatory, or is private travel insurance accepted?
questions.whyItMatters: Inadequate private insurance can prevent university matriculation on arrival.

questions.text: Does the institution guarantee student dormitory housing or require private rentals?
questions.whyItMatters: Severe housing shortages in student cities force costly emergency hostel stays.

questions.text: Can a student bring a spouse or dependent children, and do they have work rights?
questions.whyItMatters: Many countries recently banned dependents on standard taught master's courses.

questions.text: How long does document legalization and visa appointment waiting take?
questions.whyItMatters: Visa waitlists in peak summer seasons regularly exceed 10 to 14 weeks.

categories.name: Government Schemes
categories.description: Audit government subsidy programs, social welfare eligibility, documentation, and disbursement.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Clean Energy Residential Solar Rooftop Subsidy Scheme
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are the exact subsidy slabs, vendor approvals, and bank disbursement rules?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify eligibility threshold, approved installer registry, and post-installation inspection timeline.

questions.text: Who is eligible: income category, land ownership, residence status, and exclusions?
questions.whyItMatters: Government schemes strictly exclude taxpayers or commercial meters without prior warning.

questions.text: How is the subsidy disbursed (Direct Benefit Transfer to bank vs upfront discount)?
questions.whyItMatters: DBT transfers often take 6-12 months to clear, requiring full upfront liquidity.

questions.text: Must equipment be purchased solely through empaneled vendors or any certified vendor?
questions.whyItMatters: Purchasing from an unlisted vendor entirely cancels subsidy reimbursement eligibility.

questions.text: What official identification and property ownership certificates are mandatory?
questions.whyItMatters: Mismatched names on electricity bills vs ID cards causes indefinite application freeze.

questions.text: What is the technical inspection, commissioning, and net-metering approval timeline?
questions.whyItMatters: Delays by utility inspectors can leave installations idle for months.

questions.text: What is the sunset date or allocated budgetary ceiling for this scheme cycle?
questions.whyItMatters: Applications submitted after budget exhaustion are queued indefinitely without funding.

questions.text: Does the scheme mandate a multi-year warranty or maintenance service contract?
questions.whyItMatters: Beneficiaries must know whether repairs are covered free of cost for 5 years.

questions.text: Where can delayed payments or corrupt official delays be escalated?
questions.whyItMatters: Citizen charters stipulate time-bound resolution windows for administrative delay.

categories.name: Shopping and Products
categories.description: Inspect product specifications, warranties, return restock fees, and hidden subscription costs.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Smart Home Robotic Vacuum Cleaner Model X Purchase Review
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are the true subscription costs, replacement part prices, and warranty exclusions?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify if AI features require a paid subscription, check battery warranty duration, and return fees.

questions.text: Are advertised smart features locked behind a mandatory paid monthly subscription?
questions.whyItMatters: Hardware may be rendered severely crippled without a recurring monthly paywall.
questions.suggestedSource: Manufacturer Terms of Service / App Store Pricing

questions.text: What components are excluded from the standard warranty (wear & tear, battery)?
questions.whyItMatters: Batteries and motors are often limited to 90 days while the chassis is advertised for 2 years.

questions.text: What is the return window, return shipping liability, and restocking fee percentage?
questions.whyItMatters: Returns on heavy or opened electronics may incur a 15-20% deduction plus return freight.

questions.text: Can consumable parts (filters, brushes, batteries) be replaced by the owner easily?
questions.whyItMatters: Glued-in batteries force expensive whole-unit replacements after 24 months.

questions.text: Does it integrate with open smart home standards (Matter, Apple Home, Home Assistant)?
questions.whyItMatters: Proprietary protocols prevent integration with existing smart home setups.

questions.text: Does the device record camera / audio feeds and upload them to cloud servers?
questions.whyItMatters: Visual cameras in private homes can upload unencrypted floorplans to third-party servers.

questions.text: What are recurring failure patterns reported after 6 to 12 months of daily use?
questions.whyItMatters: Short honeymoon review periods miss recurring gear strip or motherboard degradation issues.

questions.text: What required accessories (cables, adapters, cleaning solutions) are excluded from the retail box?
questions.whyItMatters: Missing power bricks or charging cables require immediate auxiliary spending.

categories.name: Travel
categories.description: Inspect tourist visa validity, local transit passes, tourist taxes, and cancellation policies.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Japan Autumn Travel & Transit Passes (JR Pass & Regional Cards)
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are updated regional pass rules, seat reservation mandates, and baggage limits?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Verify JR pass cost efficiency after price hike, oversized baggage reservation, and hotel city taxes.

questions.text: What is the minimum passport validity required upon entry (e.g. 6 months) and visa waiver terms?
questions.whyItMatters: Airlines deny boarding at departure if passport validity falls short by even a few days.

questions.text: Have transit passes or ticket prices changed recently, and are online seat reservations mandatory?
questions.whyItMatters: Using outdated 2023 transit blog articles causes budgeting errors due to major price overhauls.

questions.text: Are there mandatory pre-booking rules or surcharges for oversized luggage on express trains?
questions.whyItMatters: Bringing large luggage without reservation incurs immediate penalty fees and refusal of transit.

questions.text: Are there local municipal tourist accommodation taxes payable directly in cash at check-in?
questions.whyItMatters: Prepaid online hotel bookings frequently omit city taxes levied on-site per person per night.

questions.text: Are major attractions subject to mandatory timed-entry lottery reservations or seasonal closures?
questions.whyItMatters: Showing up without pre-booked timed tickets can turn away visitors at top cultural landmarks.
questions.suggestedSource: Official Heritage Site / Museum Booking Service

questions.text: What are the non-refundable cancellation cutoff dates for accommodation and local transit tours?
questions.whyItMatters: Sudden weather disruptions (typhoons, blizzards) can forfeit 100% of non-refundable bookings.

questions.text: Is international contactless credit card accepted everywhere, or is local cash strictly needed?
questions.whyItMatters: Regional buses, temple admissions, and ramen shops frequently accept only physical domestic cash.

questions.text: Are vaccinations, compulsory medical evacuation insurance, or health declarations mandated?
questions.whyItMatters: Emergency medical treatment abroad without international evacuation coverage can cost $50,000+.

categories.name: General Research
categories.description: Custom investigations for unmatched topics, scientific inquiries, policy audits, or news claims.

suggestedPrompt.topic: Emerging AI Regulation and Data Privacy Compliance Standards
suggestedPrompt.mainQuestion: What are the enforcement dates, penalty frameworks, and sovereign exemption clauses?
suggestedPrompt.objective: Audit contradictory dates between draft whitepapers and enacted legislation, and identify unverified guidelines.

questions.text: What is the primary governing authority and official publication document date?
questions.whyItMatters: Relying on secondary commentary or journalistic rewrites introduces subtle misinterpretations.

questions.text: What are the effective enforcement dates, phase-in schedules, and compliance deadlines?
questions.whyItMatters: Proposed bill dates often differ significantly from enacted transition timetables.

questions.text: What are the statutory penalties, fines, or legal liabilities for non-compliance?
questions.whyItMatters: Knowing whether violation entails administrative warnings vs multi-million dollar fines is critical.

questions.text: What entities, activities, or thresholds are explicitly exempt from these requirements?
questions.whyItMatters: Small businesses, research institutes, or personal use are frequently exempted under safe harbor rules.

questions.text: Do existing secondary sources present conflicting numbers, dates, or mandates?
questions.whyItMatters: News outlets often quote outdated draft iterations of legislation rather than the final bill.

questions.text: What essential operational procedures remain undefined or omitted from the documentation?
questions.whyItMatters: Undefined technical standards leave organizations vulnerable to arbitrary audits.

questions.text: Has an independent audit or peer-reviewed assessment verified these claims?
questions.whyItMatters: Self-serving press releases require external empirical validation.

questions.text: Is there a designated ombudsman, desk officer, or official channel for clarifications?
questions.whyItMatters: Ambiguous regulatory points require formal binding written guidance requests.
